title: Encounter simulator ignores Intelligence, so caster builds read lethal
body:
## Summary
computeEncounter derives every build's damage from Strength and never reads Intelligence.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/EncounterTTKSimulator/helpers.ts:17 sets strScale from Strength and :24 multiplies damage by it; no line reads build.stats.Intelligence. A Mage (STR 15, INT 95) deals 0.3x base damage. Fixed looks like a primary-stat scale per build. The formula is a balance decision, so the card names the instrument rather than a number.

## Flow
- Open Analysis, pick Mage in the Encounter TTK Simulator
- computeEncounter scales damage by Strength only
- The verdict reads lethal across most of the level range

## Expected impact
Designers stop reading caster builds as broken. Every Mage and Sith verdict moves, and no other code consumes them.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - verdicts reflect the build's primary stat
Before: Sweep of 5 builds x 5 enemies x 50 levels: Mage 181/250 lethal, Sith Inquisitor 149/250, Warrior 80/250.
After: Not taken; depends on the chosen primary-stat rule.
Method: simulation - the Before is a real sweep, the After needs the rule chosen
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/EncounterTTKSimulator/helpers.ts:17
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/EncounterTTKSimulator/helpers.ts:24
verdict sweep: Mage lethal 181/250, Warrior lethal 80/250
instrument: The same 1250-cell verdict sweep on both arms, with lethal share per build as the figure.

title: XP table totals count 50 level-ups where the loader applies 49
body:
## Summary
The summary tiles and pacing count every row, but the generated loader never applies the level 1 row and never needs the level 50 XP.

## Description
The loader reads the row of the level just reached (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/helpers.ts LevelUp), and PlayerLevel starts at 1 (UE ARPGGameInstance.h:39), so a 1 to 50 run is 49 level-ups. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/index.tsx:223-225 still shows perLevel x 50, and :222 includes the level 50 XP. _shared/rewardPacing.ts cumulativeMinutes sums the same 50 rows, so Hours to max shares the error. _shared belongs to progression-curves-builds this wave, and fixing only the table would split a pair that agrees today.

## Flow
- Set HP/Lvl to 10
- Total HP Gained shows +500
- A generated-loader run grants 490 from levels 2 to 50

## Expected impact
The stated totals and time-to-max match the game. curveModel.test.ts pins totalXp to the last xpTotal and needs updating.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - totals match what the loader grants
Before: HP total 500 vs 490 applied at 10 HP/level; XP to max includes row 50 (35,355 XP at base 100, exp 1.5).
After: Predicted 490, and XP to max ends at row 49.
Method: simulation - walked the generated LevelUp; the fix crosses into _shared, owned by a sibling this wave
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: A test asserting the summary totals equal a replay of LevelUp from level 1 to 50 over the rows.

title: Generated LevelUp discards overflow XP and goes stale past the last row
body:
## Summary
The generated loader zeroes Experience on level-up and silently skips all rewards when a row is missing.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/helpers.ts LevelUp ends with Experience = 0.f, so XP past the threshold is lost; a big kill near a level boundary is partly wasted. When FindRow returns null (level past the table) PlayerLevel still increments, no stats apply and ExperienceToNextLevel keeps its old value. Fixed looks like subtracting the threshold, and refusing or clamping at the table's last level.

## Flow
- Award XP past the threshold
- LevelUp sets Experience to 0
- The surplus is gone

## Expected impact
Level pacing matches the XP table. Needs reading against the live ARPGPlayerCharacter XP award path, which may loop on level-ups.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - generated level-up conserves XP
Before: 1 of 1 generated LevelUp bodies zeroes Experience; 1 unguarded missing-row path.
After: Not taken.
Method: simulation - read the generated text; the UE caller decides the correct form and a UE compile was out of this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: pof_ue_compile plus a UE functional test awarding 1.5x the threshold and asserting the carried remainder.

title: Generated GE references tags the UE project does not declare
body:
## Summary
The DR generator emits ARPGGameplayTags::Data_<Attribute>_Bonus, and no such tag exists in the UE source; it also writes the deprecated StackingType.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/DRCodeGenerator/helpers.ts emits Data_${c.attribute}_Bonus for each config. A grep of the UE project Source for Data_*_Bonus returned 0 hits. The same template assigns StackingType directly, which UE 5.8 GameplayEffect.h:2407 marks UE_DEPRECATED(5.7). The file cannot compile until the tags exist, so the output needs its tag declarations or a stated prerequisite. Commit c93d6d66 fixed the constructor; it did not address these.

## Flow
- Copy GE_AttributeScaling.cpp to the UE project
- Compile
- Unknown identifier ARPGGameplayTags::Data_Strength_Bonus

## Expected impact
The generator output compiles as handed over. Only the generator text changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - generated C++ compiles against the real project
Before: 0 of 3 referenced tags declared in UE Source; 1 deprecated member write.
After: Not taken.
Method: probe - grep over UE Source and the 5.8 header; the After needs a UE compile
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/DRCodeGenerator/helpers.ts:81
Engine GameplayEffect.h:2407 UE_DEPRECATED(5.7)
grep Data_.*_Bonus over PoF/Source: 0 hits
instrument: pof_ue_compile of the generated header and source in the UE project.

title: Rest XP, achievements and prestige show invented numbers unmarked
body:
## Summary
Three live panels render hard-coded player figures with no sign that they are samples.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/rewards/RestXpSystem.tsx:9 (banked 4500, ~23 kills), src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/rewards/AchievementBoard.tsx:15 (per-achievement progress) and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/PrestigePreview.tsx:9 (cycles, hours) are constants. RestXpSystem's nextLevelXP 12000 does not follow the live curve. The sibling TimeToLevelEstimator was already moved to derived figures with a stated basis line. Either derive these or label them illustrative; which one is the decision.

## Flow
- Open Rewards
- Rest XP reads 7,800 / 12,000 regardless of the curve sliders

## Expected impact
Designers stop reading sample numbers as project state.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - displayed figures state their basis
Before: 3 panels, 0 basis labels; changing Base XP moves 0 of the Rest XP figures.
After: Predicted 3 of 3 labelled or derived.
Method: simulation - read the 3 panels; label versus derive is unresolved
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: A render test requiring a basis line in each panel.

title: Generators export values their own inputs declare invalid
body:
## Summary
The min/max on the DR and XP number inputs are not enforced, so out-of-range values reach the exported files.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/DRCodeGenerator/index.tsx setField and src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/index.tsx onChange store Number(value) unchecked. A Soft Cap of 62.5 goes into the JSON for an int32 SoftCap and is skipped as a curve key (drCurveTableCSV requires an integer). A negative HP/Lvl goes into the CSV. Clamping on each keystroke breaks typing, so the fix belongs at export or on blur.

## Flow
- Type 62.5 in Soft Cap
- Open Data Table (.json)
- SoftCap: 62.5 is exported for an int32 field

## Expected impact
Exports stay importable. A blur-time clamp changes what a user sees after leaving a field.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - exports only hold importable values
Before: 12 inputs, 0 enforce their declared range at export.
After: Not taken.
Method: simulation - read the handlers; the choice of blur or export needs a call
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: A test typing out-of-range values and asserting the generated JSON and CSV stay in range.

title: XP table overrides have no way to be set
body:
## Summary
levelOverrides is state with no setter, so its parameter is unreachable from the UI.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/index.tsx:40 destructures only the value of useState, so the Map is always empty. generateProgressionTable keeps the parameter and curveModel.test.ts passes it. Either remove the parameter (test signature changes) or build per-level overrides.

## Flow
- Grep setLevelOverrides: 0 hits
- The override branch runs only from tests

## Expected impact
Less unreachable surface, or a usable feature, depending on the call.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no unreachable parameter
Before: 0 setters, 1 parameter, 1 always-empty Map.
After: Not taken.
Method: probe - grep; removal touches a coupled test outside this round's fix list
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: Consumer grep of the overrides parameter after a decision to remove or build.

title: CSV filename rounds the exponent, so different curves share a name
body:
## Summary
The download name uses toFixed(1) while the exponent slider steps by 0.05.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_progression/_internals/XpTableGenerator/index.tsx:67 and :208 format the exponent with one decimal. CURVE_EXP_RANGE steps 0.05, so 1.55 and 1.6 both produce Exp1.6 and the header names a curve the file is not. The token-free hex in the same panels (bg-[#0d1117], 4 sites, these 2 files only) is the same kind of small drift and has no theme token to map to yet.

## Flow
- Set exponent 1.55
- Download reads ..._Exp1.6.csv
- Set 1.6: same name, different data

## Expected impact
Exported files identify their curve. Nothing parses the name.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - filename identifies the data
Before: 29 exponent steps map to 15 labels.
After: Predicted 29 steps, 29 labels with toFixed(2).
Method: simulation - arithmetic over the slider range; not built, low value against this round's budget
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: A test downloading at 1.55 and 1.6 and asserting distinct names.
